now.title: Loki S1#4
now.text: After Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 turns against Renslayer and frees Loki and Sylvie in the Time-Keepers' chamber. Renslayer orders her pruned on sight, and the Minutemen knock her out.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The judge B-15 serves loyally, then turns against.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Loyal Hunter turned traitor, whom Renslayer orders pruned.

proposed.title: Loki S1#5
proposed.text: Renslayer questions the captive B-15 about Sylvie, and B-15 tells her that revenge against the TVA is what drives Sylvie.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The judge B-15 turns against, who questions her as a captive.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hunter turned traitor, whom Renslayer holds and questions about Sylvie.

changes.evidence: Stage 2 is an exact copy of stage 1 (both S1#4). The next thing between them is in S1#5 'Journey Into Mystery': Renslayer approaches a captive B-15 in a Time Theatre to learn what drives Sylvie, and B-15 says it is revenge against the TVA (Wikipedia S1#5 also: 'After interrogating B-15, Renslayer plans to reach the TVA's true creator').

now.title: Loki S1
now.text: Sylvie spends her life running from the TVA and hunts down He Who Remains, its hidden creator, for taking her from her timeline. At the Citadel at the End of Time she ignores his warnings and kills him, splintering the timeline into a multiverse.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who hunts He Who Remains down and kills him at the Citadel.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's hidden creator, whom Sylvie hunts down and kills.

changes.evidence: He Who Remains is first named and seen in S1#6 'For All Time. Always.', where Sylvie meets him at the Citadel and kills him. A stage starting at the top of Loki S1 names him and his role as the TVA's hidden creator five episodes early.

now.title: Loki S1
now.text: Ravonna Renslayer runs the TVA for the Time-Keepers, who are a front for He Who Remains.
now.on_a_card_about_b: TVA chief who runs the agency for the Time-Keepers, a front for He Who Remains.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The hidden power behind the Time-Keepers Renslayer serves.

changes.evidence: The Time-Keepers are shown to be androids in S1#4, and He Who Remains is named as the TVA's creator only in S1#6, when Miss Minutes gives Renslayer information from him and she leaves to find free will. A stage starting at the top of Loki S1 reveals both early.

now.title: Loki S2#1
now.text: Hunter X-05 serves under General Dox in the TVA's Minutemen. She sends him to find Sylvie and to lead her troops in planting reset charges on the branching timelines.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hunter under Dox's command, whom she sends after Sylvie.
now.on_b_card_about_a: X-5's general, who sends him after Sylvie.

proposed.text: Hunter X-5 serves under General Dox, who has him gather a team of hunters to go after Sylvie.

changes.evidence: In S2#1 'Ouroboros', Dox has Hunter X-05 gather a team, supposedly to find Sylvie. Dox's real plan to bomb the branches with reset charges is only revealed in S2#2 'Breaking Brad' when Sylvie enchants him, and X-5 had already abandoned Dox's mission to live as Brad Wolfe, so he never leads the reset-charge attack.

now.title: Loki S2#1
now.text: General Dox leads the hunters who want to keep pruning the new branches, while Hunter B-15 wants to protect them. Dox raids the TVA armory and sends her loyalists out to destroy the branches.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hunter who protects the branches Dox wants pruned.
now.on_b_card_about_a: General who raids the armory to prune the branches B-15 protects.

proposed.text: Hunter B-15 argues that the TVA should leave the new branches alone, and the TVA stops pruning them. General Dox then has her hunters arm themselves, saying they are going after Sylvie.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hunter who argues that the new branches should be left alone.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: General who arms her hunters, saying they are going after Sylvie.

split.title: Loki S2#2
split.text: General Dox's hunters bomb the new branches with reset charges and destroy most of the timelines B-15 wants protected before Dox is captured.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Hunter who wants the branches protected that Dox's hunters destroy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: General whose hunters destroy most of the branches B-15 wants protected.

changes.evidence: S2#1 'Ouroboros': B-15 argues to let the branched timelines be, Judge Gamble orders the TVA to stop pruning, and Dox has hunters heavily arm themselves for a supposed mission to find Sylvie. Dox's actual plan to destroy all the branches with reset charges is revealed and carried out in S2#2 'Breaking Brad', where most branches are destroyed and Dox is captured.

owner_calls.question: Keep 'friend' and the claim that Diamondback is Cottonmouth's old friend who gave him the Biggie Smalls picture?
options: Change kind to 'ally' and text to: Diamondback supplies Cottonmouth's guns through Shades, and after Cottonmouth dies he moves in on his criminal empire.
owner_calls.evidence: Sources show only a business tie: Diamondback supplies the Hammer weapons and sends Shades to back Cottonmouth up (S1#1), and offers Judas bullets (S1#5). The Biggie Smalls photograph is called Cottonmouth's own; no source says Diamondback gave it or that the two are old friends.
